1466|9e43c86b.name: Gretta Finespindle
1466|9e43c86b.text: Aww, what rotten luck! My skills aren't good enough to be of any use to you. Oh well. Talk to Fimble Finespindle over there by the loom. He's been working with leather for longer than I have.

2504|60988031.name: Donyal Tovald
2504|60988031.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

310-progress.name: Unguarded Thunder Ale Barrel
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

412-progress.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-progress.text: The Recombobulator will be up and running as soon as we have sufficient Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.
412-progress.title: Operation Recombobulation

579-progress.name: Donyal Tovald
579-progress.text: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
579-progress.title: Stormwind Library

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

94792-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94792-accept.text:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a $c.
94792-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94792-progress.name: Josephine Carson
94792-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94792-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94793-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94793-accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young $c.
94793-accept.title: Training the Beast

94793-complete.name: Isaac Chan
94793-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94793-complete.title: Training the Beast

94863-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94863-accept.text:
You've alraedy mastered taming a boar, now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a $c once more.
94863-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94864-progress.name: Josephine Carson
94864-progress.text: Go forth, $N, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.
94864-progress.title: Taming the Beast

95041-complete.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-complete.text: These cards seem a bit damp... but I can work with this! Thank you, $N!
95041-complete.title: Data Hoarders

95041-progress.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-progress.text: How is the data retrieval progressing?
95041-progress.title: Data Hoarders

95065-complete.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-complete.text:
Great timing! Caught a big one with my last bait. Great day so far. They're really biting out here!

Tell you what, since you were kind enough to keep this old man in business how about a few fish for the road?
95065-complete.title: Fishin' Time

95065-progress.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-progress.text: Did you get the fishing supplies?
95065-progress.title: Fishin' Time

95213-accept.name: Unknown
95213-accept.text:
The keg is stamped:

BLASTING POWDER - DANGER - DO NOT HANDLE - DANGER - QUARRYMASTER AUTHORIZATION ONLY - DANGER

You get a sinking feeling that the troggs shouldn't have this. It would be best to report this to the quarry sooner rather than later.
95213-accept.title: Stolen Blasting Powder

96392-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-accept.text:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392-accept.title: Farsen's Watch

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. Hows about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

97220-accept.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
97220-accept.text:
Every day this week we've been short dockhands.

Care to ease the stress on our cargo schedule?

Take this package to the stockroom entrance of the Gatehouse. You'll find it inside Trias' Cheese shop on the second floor. The mistress, Elaine, will be quite familiar with the deliveries. The Gatehouse often has shipments arriving with more discretion to allow for ceremonial surprises on behalf of the guard's officers.
97220-accept.title: Philmor's Favor

97220-complete.name: Elaine Trias
97220-complete.text: Oh, dear. You think we want to carry that up the stairs ourselves? Keeping the valuables intact is your responsibility up until the point you drop it off.
97220-complete.title: Philmor's Favor

97220-progress.name: Elaine Trias
97220-progress.text: You looking to fill a crate with our finest aged wheels?
97220-progress.title: Philmor's Favor

97222-accept.name: Elaine Trias
97222-accept.text:
Yes, it's only a flight of stairs, but if it's such a small ask, it should be no problem for you to finish the delivery yourself! 

Trias' Cheese isn't part of the Gatehouse or their stocking inventory, but our buildings share a floor.

Place the crate outside their stockroom door--the guard will send someone for a regular pickup. They will see the package arrival and carry it inside as they return to post.
97222-accept.title: Gatehouse Goods

97222-complete.name: Elaine Trias
97222-complete.text:
Yep. There's a reason that hinge opens inwards towards them, so they don't get the door blocked by people leaving stuff anywhere they please.

Consider us professionally acquainted, $c. 

We respect your business, and expect you to respect ours.
97222-complete.title: Gatehouse Goods

99158-complete.name: Father Gavin
99158-complete.text:
Ah. Candles from Ironforge. 

While I am mostly able to live independently in my hermitage, there are a few key things that I appreciate from the city and the pious.
99158-complete.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159-accept.name: Father Gavin
99159-accept.text:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159-accept.title: Finding Warmth
